name: Three Blind Mice
description: You can't see. Squeak to see. Steal the cheese, chain the crumbs, get home with your tail. Twelve nights, a new Daily Raid every day, medals to win and a mouse to dress.

controls.action: Hold: tiptoe, silent on creaky boards
Hold: big squeak, see the room
